facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2013-0111 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 22 March 2013 following 1 recorded event in the archive, including AF-2004-001. The change request record covers 2 clauses across 2 controlled documents. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state dispositioned in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
